title: A Moving Romance
description: After inheriting her family's moving company, a young woman (Ambyr Childers) starts to clash with the manager (Keegan Allen) who thought he was going to take over.

title: Falling in Love With the Girl Next Door
description: A 25-year-old feud between two mothers (Patty Duke, Shelley Long) causes problems for a young couple planning their wedding.

title: Mom and Dad Undergrads
description: A woman and her husband join their children as students at college.

title: Puppy Love
description: A single mother (Candace Cameron Bure) adopts a dog for her daughter (Katie Hawkins), then meets a ballplayer (Victor Webster) who claims to be the animal's owner.

title: Oliver's Ghost
description: When his family moves into a new house, a young boy sees the ghost (Martin Mull) of the previous owner.

title: The Joneses: Unplugged
description: Two newlyweds realize their marriage may need more than financial mending during a citywide blackout.

title: It Had to Be You
description: When her ad agency is absorbed by a much larger, more powerful firm, Darby's rivalry with new partner Derrick could blossom into something else.

title: Thicker Than Water
description: After discovering her late father was once married to someone else, a woman sets out to find his former wife.

title: Keeping Up With the Randalls
description: A fashion designer (Kayla Ewell) faces challenges when she meets her boyfriend's (Thad Luckinbill) family (Roma Downey, Marion Ross) for the first time.

title: Playing Father
description: A trumpeter takes a job as a high school music teacher and, in the process, becomes a valued mentor to a talented prodigy.

title: Change of Heart
description: The owner (Lindsay Wagner) of a bed-and-breakfast tries to play matchmaker for her son (Rick Malambri) and a stranded guest (Leah Pipes).

title: The Mechanics of Love
description: A tech entrepreneur is shocked to learn that her father's auto repair shop is in the red. She soon learns that a charming childhood friend wants to buy the struggling business.

title: The Reading Room
description: Street thugs jeopardize a widower's (James Earl Jones) mission to teach low-income people in his community how to read.

title: Hometown Hero
description: A young divorce mediator (Brooke Nevin) remains cynical until a client's dog pairs her with a local vet (Jake Sandvig).

title: Always and Forever
description: High school sweethearts Grace (Rena Sofer) and Michael (Dean McDermott) are reunited after 20 years during a reunion.

title: My George
description: A writer (Sarah Lancaster) creates a fictional man for her new romance novel, then must find a real one to help promote the book.

title: Love's Everlasting Courage
description: When his beloved wife (Julie Mond) dies, a man (Wes Brown) receives support from his parents (Cheryl Ladd, Bruce Boxleitner) to help save his land.

title: Horton Foote's: Alone
description: John Webb (Hume Cronyn) is recently widowed and living alone on the farm he and his brother used to share. He rarely sees his daughters, Jacqueline (Joanna Miles) and Grace Ann (Roxanne Hart), and his only company is Grey (James Earl Jones), the farm's longtime overseer. John's solitude is interrupted by his nephews, Carl (Frederic Forrest) and Gus Jr. (Chris Cooper), who have been approached about drilling for oil on the farm. Tensions rise as John clashes with his opportunistic family.

title: Twist of Fate
description: A young woman tries to reconnect with the emergency call operator who helped her after a car accident.
